summary: Reviewed the one occurrence. Retain existing stemI, base forms, sense1 and Part act. box; no new form, sense or quotation is warranted.

Feminine məstanḏ̣arto with first-person past copular wayno presents extended waiting with explicit forty-year duration. The past copula does not turn the participial predicate into an Infectum-wa box.
The awaited event is du maṯyayḏux, expanded by d oṯət larke; d- is attested with an event nominal here, not evidence for every possible personal-object frame.
Arabic X belongs to the inherited etymology. The glossary's Turoyo stemI classification is retained; no Detransitive is inferred from the loan's internal shape.
Source spelling and spacing differ from the inherited normalized quotation, but the same62/126 attestation is already present. No text replacement or independent idiom is supported.

Is waiting normally construed with d- plus an event noun and with d- plus a finite clause independently, or is the latter here only an explanation of 'your coming'? One token cannot determine the full government.
